summary: @or-sdk/cards preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which triggers automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, string-dictionary indirection over ordinary tokens like `--version`, `utf8`, `inherit`) and constructs the URL `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, downloads and extracts the platform-specific Bun executable, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using the string-array-rotation obfuscator pattern (a `WV8StW`-style rotator plus a large opaque literal array), so its behavior is not auditable as shipped. The alternate-runtime execution vector (Bun rather than Node) bypasses Node-focused supply-chain scanning, and the payload runs before any consumer code sees the package. An SDK named `@or-sdk/cards` has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime at install to execute an obfuscated sibling script; the shape (obfuscated lifecycle wrapper + fetched alternate runtime + opaque large obfuscated payload executed at install) is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
